name: SDC Training & Regularization Setup
definition: Training pipeline for Self-Supervised Dual Contouring using Curriculum DeepSDF as the DIN, with regularization applied late in training.
summary: SDC Training & Regularization Setup is a self-supervised pipeline that reconstructs high-fidelity meshes from images without 3D labels by applying late-stage mesh-based regularization to align the predicted SDF with SDC-extracted geometry.
